blocks.html:
TRUCK LETTERING & DECALS IN TORONTO

With trucks being giant vehicles, it could get really expensive when you want to get a vinyl wrap for your vehicle. When all you want is a small graphic or text on your truck, it seems unreasonable to be getting a full or partial truck wrap. That is why here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we offer truck lettering & decals services as well. Decals are stickers that are cut into a specified shape and size. It could be a letter or a graphic, depending on what the client desires.

The beauty of vinyl stickers is their cost-effectiveness, ease of installation and equal, if not longer lifespan than a regular vinyl wrap. You’d be astonished to see what adding a sticker could do for the overall look of your vehicle. Vinyl Wrap Toronto has received quite a lot of requests from truck owners for decals that required an artistic mindset and willingness to accept a challenge. We are proud to say we pushed our boundaries and offered satisfactory outcomes to our clients every time.

With decals, the possibilities are endless. Anything that you can imagine can be turned into decals. The same goes for lettering. There is a large number of font styles to choose from. The client calls all the shots.

In the case of trucks, the lettering & decals jobs we get are often for commercial purposes. To put a phone number on it, that’s 90% of the time. Trucks have plenty of real estate to advertise something on them. Having that much surface to advertise something really opens up a lot more design options. Such as the size of stickers could be enlarged, or more than one decal could go on the surface because there’s plenty of it. It’s what an artist would feel about having a bigger canvas.

Lettering & Decals are preferred when you want to become creative and still remain within budget. On the flip side, in some cases, our customers ask us for personal lettering & decal jobs. Personalizing your truck is a great way to make a statement and fill hearts with envy by getting a personalized logo or quote on the vehicle.

Something that we want our clients to know about before they move ahead with their decision to get lettering or decals, is that stickers over time will protect the paint under them. So, after years when people decide to take them off, they realize the colour under the decals has remained intact while the colour of the rest of the vehicle has become has faded over time due to the sun and other environmental factors.

The wrap industry is all about innovative thinking and a capable hand to apply the vinyl onto a truck. Contact us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1B4 to know more about van signage costs, wrapping materials, etc.
